intro: The Grimtotem Satchel is a leather pouch clutched by the fallen tauren Maur Grimtotem deep inside Ragefire Chasm. Even as troggs overwhelmed him in the subterranean cavern beneath Orgrimmar, Maur shielded this pack with his dying breath. Recovering it and returning it to Thunder Bluff reveals that Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem had an active interest in whatever her clansman carried.

p: Discovered beneath the broken body of Maur Grimtotem in the depths of Ragefire Chasm, this simple pack was held in a fierce, vice-like embrace. Maur fought desperately to protect whatever it contains while surrounded and slain by savage troggs. The sheer determination required to shield a satchel above one's own life suggests its contents are far more significant than ordinary trail rations or supplies.
